title: Dreadmaul Hold
wikitext:
[[File:Dreadmaul Hold.jpg|thumb|300px|Dreadmaul Hold]]
'''Dreadmaul Hold''' is the main encampment of the powerful [[Dreadmaul]] [[ogre]]s in the northwest corner of the [[Blasted Lands]]. It is here that [[Grol the Destroyer]], a servant of the demon [[Razelikh the Defiler]], rules over the Dreadmaul. Venturing into the Hold is extremely dangerous and adventures are cautioned not to go in alone.
